results.name: competitor_with_redundant_features_rate
results.description: Proportion of choices for the overspecified competitor object in utterance trials where the competitor possesses at least two redundant alternative features.

results.name: duplicate_competitor_choice_rate
results.description: Proportion of choices for the competitor class among utterance trials where the heard word is true of a unique singleton target and a competitor object that has duplicate copies in the scene.

results.name: mumble_intermediate_feature_rate
results.description: Proportion of choices for objects with strictly intermediate feature counts among mumble trials where the display contains objects of at least three distinct feature counts.

results.name: scalar_competitor_choice_rate
results.description: Proportion of trials choosing the overspecified competitor object among utterance trials where the heard word is true of both a minimal target and a competitor with strictly more features.

results.name: mumble_empty_object_rate
results.description: Proportion of choices for the featureless object [0, 0, 0, 0] among four-object mumble trials containing at least one featureless object.

results.name: false_feature_choice_rate
results.description: Proportion of choices for an object of which the heard utterance is false (literal semantic violation) across all utterance trials.

results.name: two_object_scalar_target_rate
results.description: Proportion of choices for the minimal target object among two-object utterance trials where the heard word is true of both objects.

results.name: mumble_pairwise_rich_object_rate
results.description: Proportion of choices for the object with more features among two-object mumble trials with unequal feature counts.
